links.outcome: LLM confidence calibration when distinguishing psychiatric disorders with overlapping symptoms
links.effect: State-of-the-art LLMs performed well on noise-free DSM-5 knowledge queries but struggled to calibrate confidence when distinguishing disorders with overlapping symptoms (no numbers in the abstract).
links.quote: Our experiments show that although state-of-the-art LLMs perform well on noise-free queries that probe DSM-5 knowledge, they struggle to calibrate their confidence when distinguishing between disorders with overlapping symptoms.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs on MentalBench, a synthetic benchmark dataset grounded in DSM-5 criteria, assessing psychiatric diagnostic capabilities without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
